issues.description: SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) is specified in the problem statement/UML to return a double for financial precision, but the reference solution implements it as returning int. This signature mismatch can cause student implementations (and any tests expecting the UML signature) to fail to compile or behave inconsistently.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution (and intended API) to `public static double calculateTotalPrice(Meal meal)` and use a `double` accumulator/return value; alternatively, if int is intended, update the UML/text in the problem statement to specify int.
